item.title: Dice 0.1.8
item.description:
Dice 0.1.8 preview
- Convert SVG and every PDF page into images. - Add GIF, BMP, TIFF and native AVIF export, plus macOS-supported RAW input. - Extract GIF frames and TIFF pages into separate batch entries. - Resize all changes resolution only and skips images already smaller than the target. - Start now processes and saves copies beside originals or in a configured export folder in one action. - Command-comma opens Settings inside the Dice window. - Cache previews within a 32 MiB budget and reuse metadata when paging. - Show resize cursors around window edges and corners. - Remember optional default export folder and format, plus opt-in automatic update checks in Settings.

item.title: Dice 0.1.7
item.description:
Dice 0.1.7 preview
- Give search fields breathing room below the header. - Align batch counts and image details with the bottom pager. - Copy metadata values directly from each row. - Fix the application launch loop so image imports can finish promptly. - Add screenshots and first-launch instructions to the README.

item.title: Dice 0.1.6
item.description: Dice now includes Check for Updates in the application menu, with signed downloads from GitHub Releases. Preview releases can be enabled or disabled. Checks are manual by default, and updates wait for active image work and unsaved processed copies before restarting.
